result.reason: The operative language satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It is not minimal because it additionally requires all insurance to be maintained at Garman's expense for one year after the Agreement ends, neither of which was necessary to satisfy the stated position. The original headings provision remains unchanged, and no contradiction is introduced. Drafting quality is otherwise strong, though applying the same one-year post-termination period indiscriminately to all coverage types is potentially overbroad.
